name: Puranium Energy Ltd.
summary: Puranium Energy Ltd. specializes in uranium exploration, conducting operations across Canada, Australia, and the Philippines. The company holds an 85% stake in seven exclusive prospecting licenses in Namibia, Africa, spanning 93,514 hectares. Furthermore, it completely owns the Cobalt Mountain property, an approximately 4,921-hectare site situated in the Omineca mining division of Northwest British Columbia. An option agreement also allows Puranium to acquire a 100% interest in the Haines Property, which consists of 35 mineral claims in Ontario, Canada. The company, formerly known as Monterey Minerals Inc., changed its name to Puranium Energy Ltd. in March 2022. Its corporate office is located in Vancouver, Canada.
